blocks.h2: Garbage Disposal Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: Why does my disposal hum but not spin?
items.answer: Usually something is stuck. Turn it off and don't keep running it. Try the reset button and the hex key under the unit. If it won't turn, call us.

items.q: Should I repair or replace it?
items.preview: If the housing leaks or it's over 10 years old, replace it.
items.answer: If it leaks from the body or is more than about 10 years old, a new unit is usually the better choice.

items.q: Can you install a disposal in a prep sink?
items.preview: Usually, if there's power and drain space.
items.answer: Usually. We need power under the sink and enough room for the unit and drain connections.

items.q: Why does the dishwasher back up when the disposal is clogged?
items.answer: The dishwasher usually drains through the disposal. When the disposal or the drain past it clogs, the dishwasher can't empty.

items.q: What size disposal should we get?
items.preview: It depends on how you cook.
items.answer: For most households, a three-quarter or one horsepower unit handles daily use well and runs quieter. We'll recommend one for your kitchen.

items.q: Can you install a disposal with a batch feed?
items.answer: Yes. Batch feed models only run with the cover in place.

items.q: How much does garbage disposal replacement cost in Hinsdale?
items.preview: It depends on the unit. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the unit and the connections. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
